name: Turbosmart Boost Tee Manual Boost Controller
title: Turbosmart Boost Tee Manual Boost Controller
description:
The TS-0101-1101 Turbosmart Boost Tee is a reliable, budget-friendly manual boost controller designed to increase boost pressure above base wastegate level.

Technical Specifications:

Adjustment Mechanism: Mechanical detent system with positive index clicks for precise boost adjustment.

Gated Design: Integrated detent system prevents boost spikes and speeds up wastegate spool-up by delaying gate crack pressure.

Construction: CNC-machined anodized billet aluminum body with stainless steel internal components.

Connections: Dual 1/8" NPT fittings with brass hose barbs for easy inline installation into wastegate pressure lines.

Mounting: Includes a heavy-duty mounting bracket for secure engine bay placement.

name: Turbosmart Boost Gauge 30psi 52mm
title: Turbosmart Boost Gauge 30psi 52mm
description:
The TS-0101-2023 is a reliable 52mm mechanical boost gauge engineered for accurate real-time manifold pressure and vacuum monitoring up to 30 PSI.

Technical Specifications:

Scale & Range: Mechanical vacuum to 30 PSI display.

Dial & Lighting: High-contrast black face with a sleek silver bezel and bright backlighting for easy viewing day or night.

Size & Fitment: Standard 52mm (2-1/16") diameter for seamless pod or dash mounting.

Operation: 100% mechanical sweep—requires no electronic sensors for direct manifold pressure reading.

Includes: Comes complete with panel mounting bracket, vacuum line, and brass T-fitting.

name: Turbosmart Dual Stage Boost Controller V2
title: Turbosmart Dual Stage Boost Controller V2
description:
Fast, reliable on-the-fly boost switching. The Dual Stage Boost Controller V2 lets you toggle between a conservative street setting and full track boost at the flip of a switch.

Features
Instant Dual-Stage Switching: Switch between two independent boost settings (Low/High) via an in-cabin 12V toggle.

Faster Spool: Closed-loop pneumatic design prevents premature wastegate opening to eliminate lag.

Precision Tuning: Knurled adjustment dials with positive detents prevent setting drift under vibration.

Billet Construction: CNC-machined 6061-T6 aluminum body with 1/8" NPT ports built for high heat and zero leaks.

Specs
Range: 0–30+ PSI (wastegate spring dependent)

Ports: 1/8" NPT with brass barbs

Compatibility: Internal and external wastegates

Includes: Controller, 12V solenoid, toggle switch, wiring, barbs, and mounting bracket.

name: Turbosmart BOV Kompact Dual Port
title: Turbosmart BOV Kompact Dual Port
description:
The Turbosmart Kompact Dual Port BOV is a direct-replacement performance blow-off valve designed to upgrade weak, plastic factory bypass valves.

Its hybrid Dual Port design vents both to the atmosphere for a crisp BOV sound and back into the intake to keep ECU air-metering clean and avoid rich running conditions or fault codes.

Features
Dual Port Hybrid Venting: Reroutes part of the charge air into the intake and vents the rest to atmosphere for BOV sound without ECU issues.

Holds High Boost: Billet aluminum body and internal brass piston eliminate high-boost leaks common on OEM plastic diaphragms.

Sharper Response: Quick-acting piston reduces turbo lag between gear shifts and protects the compressor wheel against surge.

Direct Bolt-On: Engineered to mount using factory manifold locations and vacuum connections.

Specs
Material: CNC-machined 6061-T6 billet aluminum body.

Internal: Anodized high-flow aluminum/brass piston with high-temp seals.

Compatibility: Universal NPT hose barb models or vehicle-specific direct-fit options available.

In the Box: Kompact Dual Port BOV, mounting hardware, and vacuum line adapter.
